manualCallerVerification_2026-09-08.correctedConclusion: Exactly ONE verified live runtime canonical writer of atlas_packets exists: canonical-id-hierarchy.ts, reached via the Go retrieval dispatch path. It uses a narrow conflict policy (only updated_at refreshed on conflict, never overwriting identity/content columns), which differs materially from packet-materializer-pipeline.ts's full-column-overwrite conflict policy -- if the latter is ever wired in, its conflict semantics would silently diverge from the former's. The gate's automated count of 4 canonical candidates was inflated by a basename-cooccurrence false-positive (gan-deep-audit.ts) and two test-only files; the true count of LIVE, PRODUCTION-WIRED canonical writers is 1, which satisfies the ownership invariant for identity columns specifically -- but two production-capable, fully-built, unowned writers (packet-materializer-pipeline.ts, promotion-executor.ts) with DIFFERENT conflict semantics than the live one remain a real risk if either is wired in later without reconciling conflict policy first.
